title: Café & Bar
description: Easy phrases for cafés, bakeries, juice bars and casual bars.

phrases.pt: Um café com leite, por favor.
phrases.ipa: ũ kaˈfɛ kõ ˈlej.tʃi poʁ faˈvoʁ

phrases.pt: Quero um suco de laranja natural.
phrases.en: I want a fresh orange juice.
phrases.ipa: ˈkɛ.ɾu ũ ˈsu.ku dʒi laˈɾɐ̃.ʒɐ na.tuˈɾaw

phrases.en: What is this savory snack filled with?

phrases.pt: Me vê uma água com gás.
phrases.ipa: mi ve ˈu.mɐ ˈa.ɡwɐ kõ ɡas
phrases.note: “Me vê...” is a casual, common way to order at a counter.

phrases.en: Shall we order a shared appetizer?
